name: Accept complaint submission
description: Mark a complaint intake as complete once identity and required documents are present.

name: Request missing evidence
description: Ask the citizen to provide identity proof or residence proof when absent from the complaint packet.

name: Issue residence confirmation
description: Issue or confirm the residence record used by the complaint process.

name: decide_complaint
description: Issue the initial decision for an assigned municipal complaint.

name: decide_complaint_appeal
description: Issue the final appeal decision without acting as the initial decision-maker.

name: review_contribution
description: Demo/test-only authority to review a contribution; not a live or legal approval.
